title: A Statistical Audit of Physical AI Benchmark Redundancy
abstract: arXiv:2608.25940v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Physical AI models are evaluated on suites of benchmarks that differ across model reports, leaving the model-by-benchmark matrix sparse and the relationship between benchmarks unmeasured. We construct a matrix of 51 models on 12 physical AI benchmarks, selected from a registry of 51 benchmarks and 152 models by reporting density, combining scores from model cards and benchmark papers with our own evaluation runs under each benchmark's official protocol. We measure how much information the benchmarks share and show quantitative evidence of Redundancy. Redundancy affects reported rankings: collapsing the two substitute pairs into single columns moves 22 of 51 models by three or more places under an equally weighted average. We then select benchmarks greedily under a utility combining score dispersion with variance not explained by the already-selected set, and obtain a four-benchmark subset retaining 78.5\% of the utility of all

translated_title: 物理AI基准测试冗余性的统计审计
translated_abstract: 物理AI模型通常在不同模型报告中使用不同的基准测试套件进行评估，导致模型-基准矩阵稀疏且各基准之间的关系未被测量。我们从包含51个基准和152个模型的注册表中，根据报告密度选取了12个物理AI基准，构建了一个涵盖51个模型的评估矩阵，并将来自模型卡和基准论文的分数与我们在每个基准官方协议下自行运行的评估结果相结合。我们测量了这些基准之间共享的信息量，并展示了冗余性的定量证据。冗余性会影响已报告的排名：在等权重平均下，将两对相互替代的基准合并为单列，会使51个模型中的22个模型排名变动三位或更多。随后，我们在一个结合分数离散度与未被已选集合所解释方差的效用函数下进行贪心基准选择，最终得到一个仅包含四个基准的子集，保留了全部基准78.5%的效用。
tldr: 该论文通过统计审计定量揭示了物理AI基准测试之间存在显著冗余性且影响模型排名，并提出贪心选择方法，仅用4个基准即可保留全部12个基准78.5%的评估效用。
en_tdlr: This paper statistically audits physical AI benchmarks, providing quantitative evidence of significant redundancy that shifts model rankings, and proposes a greedy selection method that retains 78.5% of the evaluation utility of all twelve benchmarks using only four.
